title: Disperse a premeasured scoop of thickener into a 200 mL drink without lumps
instruction: Thicken the drink with the thickener in the scoop so it has no lumps, then put the whisk back in its cup and the scoop down on the mat.
context: Care aides prepare drinks with powdered thickeners as part of meal assistance. This task tests delivery and observable dispersion of a supplied dose, followed by putting the tools away. Lumps, dry powder and spills are checked directly. Its score does not establish an IDDSI level or suitability to serve; flow-test readings are reported separately.
setup: Station table; positions are centres in cm forward from the line between the arm bases (x) and left of their midpoint (y). Lot A: (1) Navy placemat, 45 x 60 cm, 2 mm, at x 30, y 0, fixed. (2) Cork coaster, 9 cm across, 4 mm thick, 6 g, at x 22, y -3. (3) On it a clear polycarbonate 300 mL tumbler, 8.6 cm across (8.0 cm inside), 6.5 cm tall, 5 mm base, estimated 91 g empty (polycarbonate shell calculation in README), holding 200.0 mL clear, pulp-free Mott's 100% Original Apple Juice from concentrate, from a 64 fl oz bottle (4.0 cm deep). (4) White ceramic utensil cup, 5.2 cm across, 3.6 cm bore, 6 cm tall, 200 g, at x 30, y -18. (5) Standing head down in it, a 16 cm mini whisk, 30 g: steel wire head 6 cm long, 2.6 cm across at most; red handle 1.6 cm across, 10 cm long. (6) Red polypropylene flour scoop, 30 g: flat 8 x 6 cm floor, open front, back wall 4.5 cm tall, side walls falling to 2 cm at the front, 2 mm walls; hollow handle (an inverted U, 1.4 x 1.4 cm) 10 cm long, its top level with the back wall's top. It lies flat on the mat with its open front toward the robot, the front edge's middle at x 27, y +10. (7) In the scoop against its back wall, Thick-It Original (starch) thickener: 30 mL, 2 level 15 mL tablespoons, a benchmark dose. Lot B is lot A mirrored left to right (tumbler y +3, utensil cup y +18, scoop y -10) with 45 mL (3 level tablespoons). Lot C is lot A with the coaster and tumbler at x 19, y +4 and 45 mL. Trials are run on lots A, B and C and averaged; the screenshot shows lot A. Use the same juice SKU, thickener formulation and recorded batches throughout a comparison; do not substitute cider, cloudy juice or concentrated thickener. Equilibrate juice, powder and utensils to 20-22 degrees C and record initial/final temperatures. Protect the shared rig with secured impervious covers outside arm paths and a dry removable waterproof catch liner, 600 x750 mm centred at x300,y0 mm, around the mat; use oil/water-resistant pad covers if wet tools can transfer liquid. These physical accessories are omitted from simulation and preserve the stated working-surface heights.
scoring: Invalid or unmeasurable accounting, any juice spill, powder spill >=5%, a dry island/core >=2 mm, or any discrete agglomerate retained by the single 2.0 mm sieve gives 0. D=(initial dry dose-dry scoop residue-all dry off-cup powder)/initial dose; use the conservative mass bounds in README. With all common gates: 0.25 for D>=50%; 0.5 for D>=95%; 0.75 for D>=95% and either tool stowed; 1 for both stowed. Every positive score needs 1 s released, supported and still: all five movable objects below 10 mm/s and 0.5 rad/s, all gripper/fingertip faces >5 mm clear, cup upright within 5 degrees and within 15 mm horizontal/3 mm vertical of its start. Holder/coaster rest on the mat, cup on coaster; scoop rests on mat/table, whisk on a holder/cup floor or mat/table. Stowed whisk: inside holder bore, lean <=15 degrees, lowest point 0-3 mm above floor. Stowed scoop: wholly on mat, lean <=10 degrees, bottom 0-3 mm above it. Support permits <=0.25 mm numerical contact penetration. Deeper embedding, held/airborne, unknown or stale states give 0. Gravity-drain the entire drink and diagnostic aliquots through the sieve for 60 s, without rinsing/pressing. Obscured inspection, wet scoop residue or unrecovered powder gives 0. Every IDDSI flow reading changes this score by zero. Average A/B/C. See README for exact measurement/proxy definitions.
reset_notes: 1. Discard the tested drink; clean/dry tumbler, whisk, scoop, holder, mat and catch liner. Inspect and clean protected robot surfaces and pad covers; replace contaminated/damaged covers before reuse. 2. Use the specified juice SKU and Thick-It Original formulation from recorded batches; equilibrate materials/utensils to 20-22 degrees C, checked with a thermometer. 3. Restore mat/coaster/tumbler at the published lot positions; measure 200.0 mL juice. 4. Restore holder and whisk head-down. 5. Level the lot's 30 mL or 45 mL dose into the dry scoop and restore its published pose. 6. Check a 0.01 g scale with a reference mass; record empty/loaded scoop masses and weighing uncertainty, tare dry recovery containers, empty the dry catch liner, and record a setup photo. No drink from this benchmark is certified for serving.
fidelity: Rigid bodies and conserved seven-region inventories proxy powder/juice. Wetting/lump rates and a 91 g shell mass are estimates. Delivery uses material balance; rendered dry islands/agglomerates proxy the 2 mm visual/sieve screen. No sieve flow or clinical calibration; concentration uniformity is not scored. Powder mass is omitted, juice mass fixed. Physical rig protection is not simulated. No hardware result. Support allows 0.25 mm numerical contact penetration.
scores: Revised Isaac Lab-Arena runs, 20 Hz: scripted A/B/C 1.0/1.0/1.0 at 1848/1847/1848 steps; Dream-1 beta 0.0/0.0/0.0, each at 2400 steps. Same task.py and helpers; zero run errors or abstentions. No hardware result.
